original_description: Author, evolve, and validate C4 model architecture documentation as Structurizr DSL (workspace.dsl). Use this skill whenever the user mentions Structurizr, C4, architecture diagrams, system context / container / component diagrams, deployment or dynamic diagrams, system landscape, documenting how a system or its microservices are structured, or asks to create or edit a .dsl workspace — even if they never say the word "Structurizr". Also use it when linking ADRs (architecture decision records) into architecture documentation.
best_description: Author, evolve, and validate C4 model architecture documentation as Structurizr DSL (workspace.dsl). Also use it when linking ADRs (architecture decision records) into architecture documentation.
final_description: Use this skill for two jobs on a C4 architecture model in Structurizr DSL (workspace.dsl). (1) Model how a software system is structured — its people, software systems, containers, components, and connections — as system-context, container, component, deployment, dynamic, or system-landscape views; create or edit a .dsl workspace; or map how microservices fit together, even when the user never says "Structurizr" or "C4". (2) Wire EXISTING decision records (ADRs in doc/adr or similar) into that architecture documentation so the C4 views or workspace link to and show the related decisions — attaching already-written ADRs, not authoring them. Don't use it for cloud diagrams made of real vendor icons (AWS EC2/RDS/S3, draw.io art), for sequence or flow diagrams, or for writing, revising, or superseding an ADR's decision text.
